Questions

Common questions.

Can you migrate our existing member records?

Yes. Member balances, loans and history are imported and reconciled before go-live.

How is member data protected?

Role-based access, encryption, backups and audit logs, aligned with the Kenya Data Protection Act.

Can members use it on their phones?

Yes. Members can check balances, statements and loan status from a phone.
